tweet.text:
Random routing on a multi-instance LLM endpoint wastes your prefix cache.

SageMaker Inference now has PREFIX_AWARE: same prompt beginning → same instance, so the KV cache actually warms. On Llama 3.1 70B (7× ml.p5.48xlarge, long 8k shared prefixes): P50 TTFT down up to 77%, KV hit rate ~25% → >80%, throughput +15–16%. Routing overhead 1.3–1.9ms.

Overload protection still spills to a quieter instance. You set PrefixLength + ConcurrencyThreshold on the variant — no container rewrite.

If your fleet still RANDOM-routes shared system prompts, you're recomputing prefixes you already paid for.

https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/reduce-llm-latency-with-prefix-aware-routing-on-amazon-sagemaker-inference/
